# `cast`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
cast(expr AS type)
```

Casts the value `expr` to the target data type `type`. `expr` :: `type` alternative casting syntax is also supported.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `conversion_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT cast('10' as int);
```

Result:

```text
10
```

```sql
SELECT '10' :: int;
```

Result:

```text
10
```
